segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: So if you are one of those people who hasn’t found the perfect physical activity yet, here are some things to think about which might help you make the right decision for you.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The first question to ask yourself is whether you would enjoy training in a gym.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Many people are put off by the idea of having to fit a visit to the gym into their busy day.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: You often have to go very early or late as some gyms can get very crowded but with regular training you’ll see a big difference in a relatively short space of time. [[ ]] Running has become incredibly popular in recent years.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: That’s probably got a lot to do with the fact that it’s a very accessible form of exercise that anyone can run even if you could only run a few meters to begin with [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: But make sure you get the right shoes.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It’s worth investing in a high quality pair and they don’t come cheap.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Another great thing about running is that you can do it at any time of day or night.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The only thing that may stop you is snow and ice.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Swimming is another really good way to build fitness.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: What attracts many people is that you can swim in an indoor pool at any time of year [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: On the other hand, it can be quite boring or solitary.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It’s hard to chat to people while you’re swimming lengths.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Cycling has become almost as popular as running in recent years.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: That’s probably because as well as improving their fitness many people say being out in the fresh air in a park or in the countryside can be fun [[ ]] , provided the conditions are right of course.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Only fanatics go out in the wind and rain.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Yoga is a good choice for those of you looking for exercise, which focuses on developing both a healthy mind and body.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It’s a good way of building strength and with the right instructor there’s less chance of hurting yourself than with other more active sports.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: But don’t expect to find it easy.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It can be surprisingly challenging, especially for people who aren’t very flexible.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Getting a personal trainer is a good way to start your fitness program.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Obviously there can be significant costs involved.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: But if you’ve got someone there to encourage you and help you achieve your goals, you’re less likely to give up.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Make sure you get someone with a recognised qualification though.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Or you could do yourself permanent damage. ( & ) —————– Whatever you do, don’t join a gym and you’re sure you’ll make good use of it.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: So many people waste lots of money by signing up for membership and then hardly ever go.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: What happens to their good intentions?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: I don’t think people suddenly stop caring about improving their fitness or decide they have more important things to do.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: I think people lose interest when they don’t think they’re making enough progress.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: That’s when they give up hope and stop believing they’ll ever achieve their goals.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Also, what people sometimes don’t realize when they start is that it takes a lot of determination and hard work to keep training week after week, and lots of people don’t have that kind of commitment ( & ).

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: One thing you can do to help yourself is to set manageable goals [[ ]] , be realistic and don’t push yourself too far.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Some people advise writing goes down but I think it’s better to have a flexible approach.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Give yourself a really nice treat every time you reach one of your goals [[ ]] and don’t get too upset if you experience setbacks.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It’s a journey.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: There are bound to be difficulties along the way.
